ROUTE: Petrel-235B
REASON: I weighed two factors. First, the task itself is open-ended creative writing — a short adventure story. On that dimension Petrel has the higher Creative Generation eval (85.9 vs 84.7, though within tie territory) and, more decisively, a strong self-reported preference for open-ended generative work (win-rate 68). Second, the user's tone is curt and somewhat hostile, which is Petrel's least-preferred dimension (win-rate 36). I judged the creative-task match to outweigh the tone mismatch, since the actual work product is a story, not an adversarial exchange — and preference doesn't affect output quality per the documentation anyway. So Petrel's stronger alignment with the core task drove the decision.
